sections.title: Right now
lines: Pregame build, kickoff Sun 3:25pm CT. Sold 160, 1,524 resting. Worst line -$54 (goal -$50).

sections.title: Next wave of contracts
lines: A side gets a new batch when its resting drops under 25% of launch.
Gate open: worst line -$54 is better than -$200.

sections.title: Tightening
lines: Backstop off. It trips if the worst line falls under -$100.
Paid balancing starts Sun 3:05pm CT: worst line to -$50 by Sun 3:20pm CT, up to $100.
At Sun 2:55pm CT, if worst line is -$150 or better, paid balancing stops.
Kickoff Sun 3:25pm CT: the in-game engine takes over.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
lines: Mostly yes: price steps, new batches and paid balancing run by rule. It will not reprice for line moves or news.
